title: AlarmPublication
description: Alarm or event published by the AlarmDetector on 'Alarms.GameMaster' (true values and all controls) or 'Alarms.HMI.<destination>' (values received by the destination, controls sent from the HMI), destination sanitized as the NATS topics

label.description: Displayed name (alarm label, or the id)

time.description: Simulation time (time_sent for the SCADA side)

alarm.description: True for an alarm (alarm and event lists), false for an event only

normal.description: Back to the normal state: ends the persistent alarms of this id

initial.description: Condition already on at start (t = 0, first value of a measurement, or after a restart from a dump): a persistent alarm not in its normal state, or a threshold crossed (OverloadMonitor only, not an alarm when momentary)

monitor.description: Shown in the OverloadMonitor while not normal (threshold types, monitored state types)

limit.description: Threshold types: threshold of the level crossed (absent when back to normal)

side.description: Side of the equipment (branch, 3 windings transformer)

substation_id.description: Substation of the alarm config, used by Locate when the equipment is not found in the network of a backend
